word_of_the_day.definition: The prices charged for goods, services or intellectual property exchanged between related companies in different countries, which tax rules expect to match what unrelated parties would agree.
word_of_the_day.example: The audit questioned the transfer pricing on royalties paid to the group's overseas arm.
